name: saxby-taro-2023
description: Solange Saxby's 2020 PhD dissertation on taro as a colorectal-cancer-preventive dietary prebiotic was plagiarized, with passages copied near-verbatim and uncited, by 'Taro Roots: An Underexploited Root Crop' (Ferdaus et al., Nutrients 2023). Saxby discovered it in 2024 and pushed for retraction/correction. See source_url.

papers.title: The Potential of Taro (Colocasia esculenta) as a Dietary Prebiotic Source for the Prevention of Colorectal Cancer
